FAQ.heading: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.q1Question: Which areas do you operate in?
FAQ.q1AnswerTemplate: {summary}. We are the Pardes Hana business: our factory and offices are here, right next to the cemetery.
FAQ.q2Question: Which stone types are recommended for Israel's weather conditions?
FAQ.q2Answer: We recommend granite, marble and Galilean dolomite rock. These are hard stones that hold up well to heat, rain and the Israeli sun for many years. We'd be glad to show you the options at our factory and match the stone to your taste and budget.

hebron-marble.title: Hebron marble
hebron-marble.description: The familiar, much-loved stone of Israeli cemeteries, in a variety of finishes.

sections.title: About the stone
sections.text: A limestone from the Hebron hills, in a light, warm tone. It is the most common stone in Israeli cemeteries.

sections.title: Why choose it
sections.text: A traditional, familiar look; easy to work and engrave, and relatively affordable.

sections.title: Care
sections.text: An occasional clean with water and a soft brush. No special products needed.

sections.title: Combinations
sections.text: Pairs well with dark granite, river pebbles and raised lettering.

turkish-marble.title: Turkish marble
turkish-marble.description: High-quality white marble: long-lasting, in a classic, traditional style.

sections.title: About the stone
sections.text: A white-grey marble with delicate veining, imported from Turkey.

sections.title: Why choose it
sections.text: A clean, elegant look that lasts for years.

sections.title: Care
sections.text: Gentle, regular cleaning to prevent stains from leaves and dust.

sections.title: Combinations
sections.text: Suits a classic design, on its own or with a granite frame.

granite.title: Granite headstones
granite.description: Exceptional strength, an elegant look and a choice of colors: black, gray, red and blue.

sections.title: About the stone
sections.text: A very hard stone in a range of colours: black, grey, red and blue.

sections.title: Why choose it
sections.text: Exceptionally resistant to sun and rain. The polish and colour last, and the inscription stays legible.

sections.title: Care
sections.text: Almost maintenance-free; cleaning with water is enough.

sections.title: Combinations
sections.text: Several granite shades can be combined, or granite with Hebron marble, for contrast.

special.title: Special headstones
special.description: Fieldstones, artistic designs and personal carving that reflects the person being remembered.

sections.title: What it is
sections.text: Personally designed memorial stones: field stones, Galilean dolomite rock, sculpture and artistic work.

sections.title: Why choose it
sections.text: When you want a stone that says something about the person and stands apart.

sections.title: How it works
sections.text: We sit together, hear about your loved one and propose a design. We start work only after you approve it.

sections.title: Materials
sections.text: Natural rock, Galilean dolomite, and combinations with marble and granite, depending on the design.

AccessibilityPage.title: Accessibility statement
AccessibilityPage.intro: We want everyone, including people with disabilities, to be able to use this site easily and find the information they need.
AccessibilityPage.standardText: The site has been adapted to the Israeli Equal Rights for Persons with Disabilities (Service Accessibility Adjustments) Regulations, 2013, and to Israeli Standard IS 5568, which is based on WCAG 2.0, at level AA.
doneItems: The whole site can be used with a keyboard, and every page starts with a "Skip to main content" link.
The element in keyboard focus has a clear outline.
Images have text alternatives, and decorative images are hidden from screen readers.
Every field in the contact form has a label, and a field left empty is marked and announced by screen readers.
Text can be enlarged to 200% without losing content.
The site respects the operating system's "reduce motion" setting.
The site is available in Hebrew, English and Russian.
AccessibilityPage.checkedText: The site was checked with an automated testing tool (axe) on every page in all three languages, and manually for keyboard navigation.
limitationItems: The map on the contact page is embedded from Google Maps and is not under our control. The address is also shown as text, with navigation links to Google Maps and Waze.
Gallery photos have a general description (stone type and photo number), not a detailed description of each headstone.
The address is shown in Hebrew in the English and Russian versions too.
AccessibilityPage.contactText: Found a problem on the site, or need information in another way? Let us know and we will take care of it. You can also contact us about accessibility at the factory and office.
AccessibilityPage.updated: This statement was last updated on 26 November 2026.

AboutPage.metaDescription: Alper Marble is a family business working marble and stone and making memorial stones since 1965. Our factory is in Pardes Hana, right next to the cemetery.
AboutPage.title: About Alper Marble
AboutPage.intro: A family business working marble and stone and making memorial stones since 1965.
storyParagraphs: Alper Marble was founded by Moshe Alper in 1965. Since then the business has passed from one generation to the next: today his son runs it, and the grandchildren work alongside him.
Our factory and offices are in Pardes Hana, right next to the cemetery. This is where we cut, shape and engrave every memorial stone, and from here we set out to install it.
We know that families come to us at a hard time. That is why we guide every family personally, from the first conversation to the installation.
AboutPage.storyImageAlt: The Alper Marble factory yard in Pardes Hana
AboutPage.craftText: Much of the work is done by hand: engraving letters, carving decorations and finishing the stone. It takes patience and precision, and we don't cut corners.
AboutPage.craftImageAlt: Hand-carving a decoration in stone at the Alper Marble factory

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPage.intro: We respect your privacy. This page explains what details we receive through the site, why, and what your rights are.
PrivacyPage.translationNote: This translation is provided for convenience. The Hebrew version is the binding one.
PrivacyPage.whoText: This site belongs to Alper Marble, a headstone factory in Pardes Hana-Karkur. Our contact details are at the bottom of this page.
collectItems: Through the contact form: your name, phone number, preferred time for a call back and the message you write.
If you contact us by WhatsApp, phone or email, we receive only the details you choose to send.
The site's hosting provider automatically keeps standard technical data, such as IP address and browser type, for operation and security.
PrivacyPage.useText: Only to get back to you, answer your inquiry and give you a quote. We will not use your details for marketing, sell them or pass them to anyone else, except the service providers listed here.
processorItems: Resend: the email service that delivers your inquiry from the form to our inbox.
Google: the map on the contact page is embedded from Google Maps. Google may collect data and set cookies under its own privacy policy.
PrivacyPage.storageHeading: Where and for how long your details are kept
PrivacyPage.storageText: Your inquiry reaches us by email and is kept in the business mailbox. It is not stored in a database on the site. We keep it for as long as needed to handle your inquiry and order, and delete it if you ask.
PrivacyPage.cookiesText: The site itself does not use cookies, tracking, analytics or advertising tools. Only the Google map may set cookies.
PrivacyPage.rightsText: You can ask to see the details we hold about you, correct them or delete them. Contact us by phone or email and we will take care of it.
PrivacyPage.updated: This policy was last updated on 28 November 2026.
